concepts.title: HTTP caching
concepts.brief: Compare browser caching, CDN caching, and application caching.
tasks: Explain Cache-Control, ETag, and conditional requests.
Trace a request before and after a cached response expires.
Show how to avoid caching private user data.

concepts.title: Database indexes
concepts.brief: Investigate how an index changes database reads and writes.
tasks: Create a PostgreSQL table and compare EXPLAIN plans with and without an index.
Explain composite index column order with an example.
Describe storage and write overhead.

concepts.title: Idempotency
concepts.brief: Learn how to safely handle a request that arrives more than once.
tasks: Explain idempotency using a payment request.
Sketch an idempotency-key table and concurrent request handling.
Discuss expiration and retries after a timeout.

concepts.title: Queues and delivery guarantees
concepts.brief: Explore asynchronous processing and duplicate delivery.
tasks: Compare at-most-once and at-least-once delivery.
Implement or sketch an idempotent consumer.
Explain retry backoff and dead-letter queues.

concepts.title: Transactions and isolation
concepts.brief: Explore concurrent updates to shared data.
tasks: Demonstrate a lost update with two transactions.
Compare isolation levels and row locking.
Explain when a transaction cannot cover an external API call.

concepts.title: OAuth and OpenID Connect
concepts.brief: Understand delegated access and user sign-in.
tasks: Draw an authorization-code flow with PKCE.
Explain access tokens, ID tokens, and refresh tokens.
Identify where token validation and secure storage happen.

concepts.title: Observability
concepts.brief: Understand logs, metrics, and traces in a distributed request.
tasks: Trace an HTTP request through an API and database.
Choose useful latency, error, and saturation metrics.
Explain correlation IDs and secret redaction.

concepts.title: Load balancing and health checks
concepts.brief: Explore routing traffic across application instances.
tasks: Compare layer 4 and layer 7 balancing.
Distinguish readiness, liveness, and startup checks.
Explain connection draining during deployment.

concepts.title: Consistency and replication
concepts.brief: Explore the behavior of replicated data.
tasks: Explain a stale read after a successful write.
Compare strong and eventual consistency for a shopping cart.
Describe read-your-writes behavior and its cost.

concepts.title: Timeouts and circuit breakers
concepts.brief: Learn how services limit the impact of dependency failures.
tasks: Choose a timeout budget for a chain of API calls.
Explain exponential backoff with jitter.
Sketch circuit breaker states and recovery.

concepts.title: Infrastructure as code state
concepts.brief: Explore how Terraform maps configuration to cloud resources.
tasks: Explain configuration, state, and real infrastructure.
Describe state locking and drift detection.
Outline secure remote state storage and recovery.

concepts.title: Network boundaries
concepts.brief: Explore private subnets and application connectivity.
tasks: Trace traffic from a public load balancer to a private API and database.
Explain routes, security groups, and NAT.
Describe how a VPC-connected Lambda reaches a private database.

systemDesign.title: URL shortener
systemDesign.brief: Design a URL shortener for 1 million new links per day and 100 million redirects per day.
tasks: Clarify link expiration, custom aliases, and abuse controls.
Estimate average and peak requests and storage.
Define create and redirect APIs and a data model.
Draw components and explain caching, collisions, and outages.

systemDesign.title: Notification service
systemDesign.brief: Design email, SMS, and push notifications for 100,000 users.
tasks: Define preferences, delivery latency, and provider limits.
Design an API, queue, and worker flow.
Handle duplicates, provider outages, retries, and dead letters.
Choose monitoring signals and explain delivery status semantics.

systemDesign.title: File upload platform
systemDesign.brief: Design private uploads of files up to 2 GB for 50,000 users.
tasks: Define upload and download APIs with authorization.
Design direct multipart uploads and metadata storage.
Handle interrupted uploads, malware scanning, and cleanup.
Explain access expiration, encryption, and cost controls.

systemDesign.title: Real-time chat
systemDesign.brief: Design one-to-one chat for 20,000 concurrent connections.
tasks: Clarify message ordering, offline delivery, and presence.
Draw WebSocket gateways, message storage, and fanout.
Design reconnect, deduplication, and pagination.
Explain scaling and authorization for every conversation.

systemDesign.title: API rate limiter
systemDesign.brief: Design rate limiting for an API with 10,000 requests per second.
tasks: Define limits per user, tenant, and endpoint.
Compare token bucket and fixed-window behavior.
Design shared state and atomic updates across API instances.
Choose fail-open or fail-closed behavior and explain tradeoffs.

systemDesign.title: Appointment booking
systemDesign.brief: Design a booking service where two users may request the same slot.
tasks: Define cancellation, time zones, and reservation expiry.
Design tables and APIs.
Prevent double booking using database constraints and transactions.
Handle payment timeouts and send reliable confirmations.

systemDesign.title: Search service
systemDesign.brief: Design searchable product listings for 1 million products.
tasks: Define filters, ranking, and freshness goals.
Design indexing from the source database.
Handle deletion, reindexing, and delayed updates.
Explain pagination, caching, and search outages.

systemDesign.title: Background job platform
systemDesign.brief: Design a job service processing 5 million jobs per day.
tasks: Define job submission and status APIs.
Design scheduling, queues, and worker scaling.
Handle duplicates, poison messages, retries, and cancellation.
Estimate throughput and choose alerts for backlog and job age.

systemDesign.title: Multi-tenant SaaS
systemDesign.brief: Design a business application serving 1,000 organizations.
tasks: Define tenant isolation and roles.
Compare shared tables with separate databases.
Design tenant-aware authorization and queries.
Explain per-tenant quotas, backup recovery, and audit logs.

systemDesign.title: Deployment platform
systemDesign.brief: Design CI/CD for a containerized API on AWS ECS Fargate.
tasks: Trace build, tests, image publishing, and deployment.
Design OIDC permissions and secret access.
Handle migrations, health checks, and rollback.
Compare rolling and blue-green deployments with cost tradeoffs.

systemDesign.title: Analytics ingestion
systemDesign.brief: Design ingestion of 50 million events per day.
tasks: Define event schema, retention, and freshness.
Estimate peak throughput and storage.
Design buffering, deduplication, and partitioning.
Handle late events, privacy deletion, and consumer outages.

systemDesign.title: Webhook delivery
systemDesign.brief: Design outbound webhooks for 10,000 customer endpoints.
tasks: Define subscriptions, event IDs, and payload signing.
Design durable delivery, retries, and endpoint isolation.
Explain ordering, duplicates, and replay.
Choose timeouts, delivery history, and failure alerts.
